svg.title: How to export your Apple Watch ECG as a PDF
svg.desc: Four iPhone screens. One: open the Health app, tap the Browse tab, then tap Heart. Two: tap Electrocardiograms (ECG) to see every recording. Three: tap the result you want, then tap Export a PDF for Your Doctor. Four: tap the Share button to print or send the PDF, or save it to Files.
